purpose: Browse a stream of items and pick one.
layout: Optional search or category chips pinned near the top, then a vertical stream of rich cards (image, title, 1–2 meta lines). A featured row may scroll horizontally above the main stream.

required: Vertical stream of item cards with image, title and meta

primaryAction.note: Tapping a card is the action; no filled button on the screen.

avoid: Every card the same height with no featured item
Text-only cards when the items are visual
